brief: Holds an amount of resources, memory, virtual processors, disk and a GPU, either as the need of a part or as the capacity of a host.
detail: The same class plays two roles. As a requirement it says what a part needs, including a GPU that is required or optional. As a capacity it says what a host offers, including whether a GPU is present. Meets asks whether a capacity covers a requirement; Plus adds requirements, as for several parts on one host. Nothing is validated: set numbers.
receiver:
o1 = new stzResourceSpec()
o1.SetMemory(2048)
o1.SetCompute(2)
o1.SetStorage(20)
